newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - NAB says focusing on Asian region.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - NAB says focusing on Asian region.

text.p: Australia's largest and most profitable bank National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) said on Monday it would continue to expand in the Asian region, while margins in its domestic market were expected to continue to decline.

"Opportunities in consumer and wholesale banking will be developed in 1996-97 as part of a carefully considered strategy to increase the group's role in (tha Asian) region," chairman Bill Irvine and chief executive Don Argus said in a joint statement contained in the NAB's 1995/96 annual report.
NAB's Asian activities accounted for 0.8 percent of its 1995/96 pre-tax operating profit which rose to A$3.06 billion from A$2.88 billion a year earlier.
The annual report also forecast intensifying competition in Australia, its largest market, leading to continued pressure on margins.
At the announcement of NAB's results last month, Argus said the bank's Australian margins were being squeezed.

NAB's net interest margin, which represents the net interest income as a percentage of average interest earnings assets, fell to 3.9 percent in the year to September 30, 1996 from 4.2 percent in the previous fiscal year.
